title: page renderer: retire the stack-the-rest branch for authored regions once the spec declares each template slots (objectstack#23610 Q2 A follow-up)
body:
Blocked-by: #12626

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23610

Filing gate: a follow-up bound by a maintainer ruling, objectstack#23610 batch #349 item 2, letter Q2 A (ruling comment 6190536588 on that card, item 5). Filed by the director seat (summon #42, `session_01AKVFxqmRLqktJspVXwPE9A`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the ruling binds upstream

`@objectstack/spec` closes `PageSchema.template` to the renderer's registered names and declares each template's slots (`default`: header, sidebar, main, aside, footer; `header-sidebar-main`: header, sidebar, main; `three-column`: the five; `dashboard`: header, footer and an open grid). A region the chosen template will not place is refused at `os validate` and at save. `full-width` retires: it is the same component as `default`.

## What this card does, after the spec lands and the pin moves

- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` (read on `origin/main` `cf430cd10e`): the stack-under-`main` branch for unplaced regions (`getRemainingRegions` at `:285`, `:384`, `:417`) becomes unreachable for authored pages; retire it for the slotted templates (`dashboard` keeps its open grid by design) and drop the `full-width` row of `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` (`:475`).
- Pins move from "an unknown region is stacked" to "an unknown region or template is refused upstream"; the renderer keeps no fallback for a shape the spec refuses.

Reader who acts: objectui triage (grade and route), then `domain:ui`. Order: after objectstack#23610's execution PR lands AND `@objectstack/spec` with the refusal is installable at objectui's pin (the cross-repo unlock is "the consumer can install", not "merged upstream").

Dedupe (objectui open `domain:ui` titles read for template, region, getRemainingRegions and stack in this act): none names this branch.
